operator_stimulus.statement: any universally valid math must be representable using the same structures and processes as lowest level physical process description at all stages of calculation
operator_stimulus.refinement: coherence of identity and available continuations, including rather than merely assuming stability of identity
operator_stimulus.instruction: Create a higher-level conjecture including mathematics and physics; make the existing top-level physics conjecture its physics branch.
operator_stimulus.authority: Authorizes programme organization, not truth, source selection, proof import or physical capability.

root.statement: Universally valid mathematical constructions admit stage-by-stage realizations using the same fundamental structures and processes as the lowest-level physical process description, coherently preserving identity, composition and the context- and resource-dependent continuations those identities license.
root.candidate_quantifiers: There exists one common process account P with a physical realization; for every mathematical construction M valid in the eventual declared foundation/scope, there is a faithful stagewise realization F_M into P, with coherent comparisons on overlaps. P is not chosen separately for each domain or fitted answer.
root.universality_policy: Universal ambition is retained. Bounded domain tests are evidence about scoped candidates, never universal closure. The meaning and admissible scope of validity and representation remain explicit formulation gates.
not_claimed: every valid statement has an effectively discoverable proof
every infinite object can be physically completed in finite time
RH is true because this programme exists
a failed candidate map refutes every realization

dependency_semantics: Necessary research obligations and candidate assembly order, not already-proved implications. A root outcome requires an independently reviewed common-witness assembly theorem and declared quantifier scope; all child successes alone do not auto-promote the root.

definitions.question: Which metatheory, universes, axioms and semantic/proof notions delimit universally valid mathematics? Do not silently replace semantic validity by decidability or enumerate only successful examples.
Specify the common source primitives and what establishes their relation to lowest-level physical processes, rather than calling a mathematical simulator physical.

Give typed maps on requests, states, operations, proof witnesses and intermediate histories, preserving composition and observations with stated higher comparison witnesses. Encoding only theorem statements/results is insufficient.
Distinguish definitional/propositional identity, equivalence, contextual equivalence and equality of one readout. State which identification each realization preserves and reflects.

Specify admissible next tasks together with types, domains, resources, environments, retained records and witnesses. Ambient matrix existence or an observable does not automatically supply an operation.

An admitted identity/equivalence carries coherent transport of licensed continuations, compatible with composition, substitution, dependencies and higher identifications. For irreversible/coarse readouts, declare the restricted tasks and lost continuations; do not demand unrestricted equivalence by fiat.

conjectures.statement: The root can be specified with noncircular validity, representation, identity and physical-process semantics.
conjectures.acceptance: Freeze definitions, universes, allowed source data, resource semantics and what finite/infinite representation means; distinguish universal target from pilot scopes.
rivals: Only a universal interpreter with answers/laws supplied
Different unrelated processes for each domain
conjectures.falsifier: A proposed definition counts arbitrary answer insertion or endpoint encoding as a full realization.

conjectures.statement: A specified source supplies composable processes, contexts, records and resource-sensitive continuation interfaces usable by both branches.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct the common interface and native process laws, preserving source provenance and distinguishing declared constructor conventions from derived laws.
rivals: A common notation with unrelated underlying operations
conjectures.falsifier: Shared labels conceal incompatible operation domains, discarded records or independently selected source laws.

conjectures.statement: Admitted identifications support coherent transport of available continuations throughout construction.
conjectures.acceptance: Supply identity/equivalence transport, substitution/composition and higher compatibility witnesses; test pairs with equal present readout and different next behavior.
rivals: Readout equality is mistaken for identity
Identity transport preserves values but loses allowed tasks or resources
conjectures.falsifier: An allegedly valid identification admits a continuation on one side with no transported witness on the other under the same context and resource policy.

conjectures.statement: The same process account faithfully realizes mathematical constructions at all stages within each explicitly tested domain, with a separate universal-extension obligation.
conjectures.acceptance: Construct domain realizations and their overlaps, keeping laws supplied by an adapter distinct from laws generated by the source. Include finite calculations, proof/dependent constructions and analytic completion tests.
rivals: Compiler wraps supplied laws without explaining them
Endpoint theorem agreement hides incompatible intermediate steps
conjectures.falsifier: An intermediate mathematical construction or licensed substitution cannot be realized by the claimed process interface.

conjectures.statement: A precise relationship to UF's identities, equivalences and dependent transport can be realized within the common account.
conjectures.acceptance: Declare the chosen UF fragment/universes and construct its type, identity, equivalence and transport laws; if claiming subsumption, prove the required interpretation/conservativity rather than import it as a slogan.
rivals: UF structure is imported unchanged and renamed a derivation
conjectures.falsifier: A dependent transport or higher coherence law fails under the proposed interpretation.

conjectures.statement: The existing relational-carrier physics programme is realized as the physical branch of the common account.
conjectures.acceptance: Retain existing physics obligations and supply their common-process binding, physical source justification and independent tests. Do not promote structural mathematics into empirical confirmation.
rivals: An abstract simulator is treated as an admitted physical process
conjectures.falsifier: A claimed physical operation lacks its required preparation, resource, environment or instrument, or fails a declared independent prediction.

conjectures.statement: Mathematical and physical realizations use one common source account and agree on shared identities and continuations.
conjectures.acceptance: Exhibit state/action/resource and observer diagrams on the same witness, including intermediate continuations. Record context-dependent comparisons instead of equating equal scalar outputs.
rivals: Successful but unrelated mathematical and physical models
A bridge is fitted to the desired scalar
conjectures.falsifier: One common-source square fails while separate endpoint predictions remain correct.

conjectures.statement: Scoped realizations extend coherently over the intended mathematical scope and assemble into the root under a justified common-witness theorem.
conjectures.acceptance: State and prove the generation/completion/coverage principles and logical assembly rule. A finite list of successful examples is not this theorem.
rivals: Finite pilots are extrapolated to universal validity
Physical finite execution is conflated with representation of limits
conjectures.falsifier: The proposed extension loses an operation, identity or continuation at a limit or across overlapping domains.

conjectures.statement: The common foundations root holds at its explicitly fixed quantifier scope.
conjectures.acceptance: Independent review of all scopes, source bindings and the assembly theorem; explicit outcome admission only.
rivals: Common generative grammar exists only in bounded fragments
conjectures.falsifier: An obstruction covers every realization permitted by the fixed root scope, rather than only one candidate.

branch_attachments.boundary: RH is a domain test, not an assumed true premise or a mandatory positive answer. The root does not imply RH without an independently justified construction/theorem. Existing rejected Evans candidates remain rejected.

candidate_evidence.scope: Supplied-domain compiler prototype; not native law discovery or universal realization.
Relative specialization with supplied domain/generator/law, not universal synthesis.
Resource-sensitive task grammar hypothesis; no physical source identity established.
Concrete candidate fails operation transport despite an abstract metric embedding; not root refutation.
Historical RH defect interpretation; scalar cancellation is insufficient and this packet is not a current proof certificate.

frontier.bounded_action: Specify one typed continuation-preserving realization interface and distinguish definitional identity, equivalence and equal-observation quotients on the existing domain-WG pilot; freeze allowed resources before a continuation hostile.
frontier.does_not_wait_for: Physical apparatus admission does not block this bounded mathematical interface task.
